title: Strip of bars?
content: I’ve definitely met other walkers here. I find myself constantly returning and longing when I sleep. People arrive alone and sit at a horseshoe-shaped or semi-circular bar, drinking incredible cocktails. It’s always dimly lit with candles and string lights. I strike up conversation and meet new people that definitely don’t seem like the regular dream characters. Almost as if they are walking too. The area stretches about five or six blocks, with bars lined up next to each other, all with open-style seating. It’s always breezy, and the streets are filled with people and friends. Please tell me i’ve met others here?
